name: Batch API — Per-line `model` in JSONL
summary: POST /v1/batches wraps other endpoints (chat/completions, responses, embeddings, moderations, videos); each JSONL line's `body.model` is the BYOM slot.
description: The Batch API itself does not take a top-level `model`; each JSONL input line contains a full request body for the wrapped endpoint (chat completions, responses, embeddings, moderations, videos) including that request's own `model`. **Verified negative:** the Foundry project OpenAI client returns `404 NotFound` when calling `aoai.batches.create(...)` — the `/batches` endpoint is not exposed on the Foundry Responses surface at all, so the BYOM prefix question is moot. Batch is a native OpenAI/Azure OpenAI feature, not a Foundry-orchestrated one.
notes:
BYOM does not work because the Foundry project OpenAI endpoint does not expose Batch API.

Verified: `aoai.batches.create` returns `openai.NotFoundError: 404` at batch creation; file upload also fails against Foundry. No BYOM prefix helps when the endpoint is missing server-side.

Tracked in `byom-incompatible-endpoints` with embeddings, TTS, STT, fine-tuning, and realtime.
